title: Reducing weight-based rejection: Identifying facilitators and barriers to positive social change using the social identity approach.
title_zh: 减少基于体重的拒绝：利用社会身份方法识别促进积极社会变革的促进因素与障碍
abstract: The social identity approach provides an innovative theoretical framework to understand the systemic nature and determinants of weight stigma and discrimination. Integrating existing evidence, we discuss the need for social identity-informed interventions to support the health of people with higher weight and increase advocacy for equity among higher weight and advantaged groups. We outline how interventions might achieve these goals by challenging the extent to which weight-based group boundaries are perceived as permeable and the inequity experienced by people with higher weight is seen as legitimate and stable. We describe three beliefs about weight and health that present key targets for interventions, as they shape weight-based social identities and inform perceptions of the legitimacy of inequity. We provide concrete directions for future research to design and evaluate new interventions aiming to promote and protect health and equity for people with higher weight. abstract_zh: 社会身份方法为理解体重歧视与歧视的系统性及其决定因素提供了一种创新的理论框架。整合现有证据，我们讨论了社会身份导向干预的必要性，以支持体重较高人群的健康，并提高体重较高人群及优势群体对公平的倡导。我们阐述了干预如何实现这些目标，即通过挑战基于体重的群体界限被视为可渗透的程度，以及体重较高人群所经历的不公平被视为合法且稳定的程度。我们描述了三种关于体重与健康的信念，它们是干预的关键目标，因为这些信念塑造了基于体重的社会身份，并影响对不公平合法性的感知。我们为未来研究提供了具体方向，以设计和评估旨在促进和保护体重较高人群健康与公平的新干预措施。（PsycInfo 数据库记录（c）2026 APA，版权所有。）
